us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump campaigns in Michigan as GOP targets open Senate seat
bullets: Trump headed to Port Huron, Michigan, for a midterm campaign rally.
Republicans are targeting the seat of retiring Democratic Sen. Gary Peters.
Democrat Abdul El-Sayed faces Republican Mike Rogers in the Nov. 3 race.

articles.title: Trump says Audi will build $4.2 billion Georgia auto plant
bullets: Trump announced the project Saturday at a campaign rally in Perry, Georgia.
Audi said the Macon-area plant would create about 4,500 jobs.
Construction is scheduled for 2027, with production in the early 2030s.

articles.title: Trump casts early midterm ballot in Florida
bullets: Trump voted Saturday at a West Palm Beach polling location.
He said he voted for Republicans across the ballot.
He later traveled to Georgia for a campaign rally.

articles.title: California election officials object to DOJ ballot-sequester demand
bullets: County registrars received Justice Department letters about alleged noncitizen ballots.
Local officials described confusion and frustration over the demand.
The dispute escalates a legal fight before the midterm elections.

articles.title: Texas Trump voter breaks party ranks amid cancer bills and inflation
bullets: AP profiled Cindy Banda, a three-time Trump voter in McAllen, Texas.
She faced breast cancer treatment and more than $25,000 in medical debt.
She cited high prices and medical costs before the Nov. 3 election.

articles.title: Brazil votes in Lula-Bolsonaro presidential runoff
bullets: Brazilians began voting Sunday in a tense presidential runoff.
Incumbent Lula faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro.
Polls showed a close contest before the vote.

articles.title: Russian strike sparks fire at Kharkiv home-improvement hypermarket
bullets: Reuters Connect listed images from a Russian strike in Kharkiv, Ukraine.
The strike reportedly engulfed a home-improvement hypermarket in fire.
The item was posted early Sunday, October 25.

articles.title: Israeli drone strike injures students at Gaza university campus
bullets: Reuters Connect listed video and images from an Islamic University strike in Gaza.
The listing said seven Palestinians were injured.
The footage was posted Sunday morning.
articles.source: Reuters Connect / Anadolu Agency / ZUMA Press Wire

articles.title: Bulgaria holds presidential election
bullets: Reuters Connect listed multiple photo items from Bulgaria’s presidential election.
Election images were posted throughout Sunday morning.
The vote was among the latest global news items on the service.

articles.title: Typhoon Champi brings weather warnings around Taiwan
bullets: A current-affairs roundup highlighted Typhoon Champi as a major world item.
The same roundup noted heavy-rain warnings connected to the storm.
The item appeared in an October 25 news digest.

articles.title: INDIA bloc plans ‘public impeachment’ campaign against CEC
bullets: Rediff’s October 25 archive reported plans targeting CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
A ‘public impeachment’ event was planned for October 30.
A ‘Dilli Chalo’ march was planned for November 1 at Ramlila Maidan.

articles.title: India extends duty-free raw sugar import deadline
bullets: A current-affairs roundup cited Reuters reporting on the sugar deadline.
India extended the deadline for one million metric tonnes of raw sugar.
The new deadline was listed as December 31, 2026.

articles.title: RBI bulletin flags inflation risks
bullets: The October 25 current-affairs roundup highlighted inflation risks in an RBI bulletin.
The item appeared alongside economy and policy headlines.
It followed an October marked by rate and price concerns.

articles.title: Urban mobility developments feature in India current-affairs roundup
bullets: The October 25 roundup listed urban mobility as a major India topic.
It grouped the item with economy and infrastructure developments.
The summary was published Sunday, October 25.

articles.title: Heavy-rain warnings issued in India roundup
bullets: The October 25 digest highlighted heavy-rain warnings among India items.
The warnings appeared in a same-day current-affairs summary.
The item was listed with national and weather developments.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and market stories

articles.title: Wall Street falls as Brent crude jumps above $116
bullets: The S&P 500 fell 0.5% Friday.
The Dow dropped 1.2%, while the Nasdaq slipped 0.2%.
Brent crude rose 3.1% to $116.72 a barrel.

articles.title: Dow loses 652 points in Friday selloff
bullets: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points Friday.
The S&P 500 closed at 7,623.68.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.99%.

articles.title: Hasbro leads weekly S&P 500 gainers after outlook raise
bullets: Torvanta listed Hasbro as up 18.9% for the week.
The move followed stronger results and a raised outlook.
The stock was among the week’s biggest S&P 500 movers.

articles.title: Construction and engineering stocks slide for the week
bullets: Torvanta said the group’s median decline was 11.9% for the week.
Comfort Systems USA fell 19.2%.
Quanta Services dropped 13.6% and Emcor lost 10.3%.

articles.title: Cybersecurity shares rally as CrowdStrike jumps
bullets: Axios reported CrowdStrike rose 8.3% in Friday’s stock spotlight.
The move came after warnings about global website vulnerabilities.
Netskope also extended gains, according to market-mover coverage.

articles.title: Audi plans first Georgia plant in $4.2 billion project
bullets: Audi said the plant would produce about 200,000 cars annually.
The facility is expected to create roughly 4,500 jobs.
Construction is scheduled to begin in 2027.

articles.title: Visa reportedly cutting 5% of workforce to prepare for AI
bullets: Kiplinger cited CNBC reporting on Visa’s planned job cuts.
The cuts equal about 5% of the workforce.
Visa’s CFO described the goal as becoming leaner and more agile.

articles.title: Markets brace for heavy earnings and economic calendar
bullets: AP said inflation, consumer confidence and GDP updates are due this week.
Major earnings reports will also dominate the calendar.
The Federal Reserve’s rate decision is in focus.

articles.title: Abbott plans nutrition-business spinoff
bullets: Axios reported Abbott plans to spin off its nutrition business.
The unit would become an independent publicly traded company.
The item appeared in Axios Pro Rata’s deal roundup.

articles.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talk advances with special committees
bullets: Axios reported Musk called a SpaceX-Tesla merger ‘a good idea.’
Both companies reportedly formed special committees to discuss a deal.
The item appeared in Axios Pro Rata’s October 23 newsletter.

articles.title: Tech companies turn to religion for AI morality efforts
bullets: AP examined how firms are seeking moral frameworks for AI systems.
The report noted concerns about simplifying religious traditions.
Meta Oversight Board member Paolo Carozza was among voices cited.

articles.title: Experts warn AI-discovered bugs could trigger new cyber disruptions
bullets: Reuters reported cybersecurity experts expect AI tools to find more vulnerabilities.
RunSafe Security’s CTO said recent model performance changed industry expectations.
The story was published October 23.
articles.source: Reuters via Blue Water Healthy Living

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Russian data centers, disrupting major services
bullets: AP’s technology brief said Ukraine hit Yandex, Sberbank and VK data centers.
The strikes disrupted key Russian digital services.
The report said AI research was also affected.
articles.source: Associated Press via News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: Zuckerberg makes Meta deal tied to California billionaire-tax measure
bullets: AP reported Mark Zuckerberg made an agreement with Meta over potential tax costs.
California’s Proposition 40 would impose a one-time 5% wealth tax.
The measure targets billionaires living in California as of Jan. 1, 2026.
articles.source: Associated Press via News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: SAP AI NOW focuses on business AI value and safeguards
bullets: ITPro covered SAP AI NOW’s keynote from the NEC.
Speakers emphasized value creation from business AI projects.
The live report also discussed kill-switch concerns after a PHP security issue.
